messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx and timeout errors observed on /v1/chat/stream across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. 5xx > 7% over 2m. Auto-page: jessica.oncall.

jessica.oncall: i'm awake. pinging SRE/runtime. Who's seeing customer errors?

rachel.support: multiple tickets and live chats reporting 'gateway error' and repeated timeouts since ~09:42 UTC. A couple of customers reported SDK retries blowing up.

marc.sre: seeing spike of 429s from quota-check microservice right before 502/504s. It looks like quota-service started returning "quota exceeded" for many internal internal-service tokens.

tina.runtime: runtime queues are filling; worker busy ratio high. slow RPCs to kv-store and retries piling up. suspect quota mis-eval caused client requests to be retried and backed up CPU.

jessica.oncall: did any config change go out recently?

deploy-bot: deploy user=opsbot service=quota-service env=prod region=global sha=9b7cde deployed at 2026-03-14T09:40:11Z

opsbot: autopilot updated quota-policy: global_enforce=true threshold=0.85 via policy engine at 09:39 UTC

marc.sre: reproduction: curl -X POST /v1/check -d '{"key":"internal"}' -> 429 when token bucket rate > threshold. Then external proxies see 502 from runtime because requests queue and time out.

tina.runtime: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) revert quota-policy toggle 2) enable traffic-shed to low-priority model variants 3) add temporary ingress rate limit for SDKs to smooth retries.

jessica.oncall: i'll hand off to marc to lead mit. marc, can you do config rollback + route changes?

marc.sre: taking lead. Rolling back quota-policy now: `opsctl config set quota/global_enforce false --env prod`

bob.sre: (note: bob is not in participants; disregard)

marc.sre: rollback confirmed by quota-service logs at 09:46 UTC. 429s dropping. Now enabling model-fallback route: `trafficctl set-split /v1/chat 0.85:primary,0.15:lite --region us-east-1`

tina.runtime: scaling runtime from 4 -> 8 replicas to drain queues: `kubectl scale deploy runtime-pool -n runtime --replicas=8`

rachel.support: sending interim customer note: "We're investigating a transient increase in errors and applying mitigations. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." Sending to impacted accounts now.

opsbot: autopilot policy change source: autoscaler incident responder triggered enforcement flip when CPU quota > 82% across region. Policy lacked cooldown/circuit-breaker.

marc.sre: after rollback + scale, 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% over 1m. seeing residual timeouts from long-running requests. Starting rolling restarts to clear hung connections.

tina.runtime: applied short TTL increase on KV caches to reduce backend pressure: `CACHE_TTL=90`. Also disabled aggressive internal retries (set RETRY_MAX=1) to prevent retry storms.

jessica.oncall: product — oliver, are enterprise SLAs impacted? Need severity decision and comms approvals.

oliver.product: initial look: three customers exceeded transient error threshold for a few minutes. Recommend S2 and follow-up credit assessment if window > 30m. I'll prepare statement for external.

marc.sre: root cause hypothesis: autoprov/autopilot policy toggled global quota enforcement without canary. The aggressive flip created a wave of 429s that led to client retries and runtime queue saturation -> 504 gateway timeouts -> 502 from upstream. Also a missing short-circuit means internal health probes also slowed.

rachel.support: CS guidance: advise customers to implement exponential backoff and jitter; offer workspace-level retry guidance and temporary workaround: set SDK maxRetries=1.

marc.sre: follow-ups: 1) add circuit-breaker to autopilot policy 2) require manual approval for global_enforce flips for 24h after deploy 3) add correlation alert: 429->504 rising together. PRs assigned to me.

opsbot: scheduled job: revert autopilot toggle and gate changes planned.

jessica.oncall: mitigation monitoring: error rate steady <1.5% for 10m. i'll monitor 45m then hand back. Marc, please own postmortem and runbook edits. Tina, own runtime config fixes. Rachel, own customer comms.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (monitoring). Severity: S2. Pages closed: jessica.oncall, marc.sre.

marc.sre: immediate action items: disable autoprov enforcement flip, add canary and rollback precondition (if error rate rises > 1% block enforcement), instrument quota-service to emit enforcement-change events to tracing, and add SDK backoff docs. ETA: PRs by EOD.

tina.runtime: longer-term: implement ingress token-bucket smoothing, add async queue backpressure metrics, and ensure health probes bypass quota checks.

rachel.support: final note for thread: customers updated, no data loss, peak affected request pct ~8.5%, most recovered within 12m of mitigation.

jessica.oncall: closing thread; will reopen if regression. thanks team :thumbsup:
